title: Lithuanian agency confirms human-error data breach in EU4Belarus SALT scholarship programme, Charter97 reports
date_note: The page gives no earlier day for the agency's confirmation to Belsat; the article's publication day is used. The agency dates the breach itself to May 2026.
geo_basis: The agency is Lithuanian; the article names no city, so the pin is a general location in Lithuania.
summary: Charter97 reports that Lithuania's Central Project Management Agency confirmed, in reply to a Belsat inquiry, a data breach in May 2026 caused by human error in the EU4Belarus SALT scholarship programme. The agency said the email addresses of some participants and related individuals became accessible within the programme community. It said affected individuals and Lithuanian authorities were informed, and gave no count of people.
plain: Lithuania's project agency says a human error in May 2026 made some scholarship participants' email addresses accessible within the programme community, according to Charter97. It says those affected were told.
exec: A Lithuanian agency says a human error exposed some scholarship participants' email addresses within the programme community; it gave no count of people.

sources.name: Charter97: The EU Scholarship Program Has Confirmed A Data Breach Involving The Personal Information Of Belarusians

validation.note: Only Charter97 read, relaying the agency's reply to Belsat; the agency's own statement and Belsat's report were not read.
